utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, last I heard it’s down to just a few odds and ends. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if anything major comes up.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll wait on Cleo’s update and then help cover whatever’s left, quietly.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good — once you send that over, I can take a few and keep it manageable.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Quinn
